an8.63:1.1: aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.63:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
an8.63:1.4: dhamme ca bhāsite mamaññeva anubandhitabbaṃ maññantīti
an8.63:1.5: desetu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti
an8.63:1.7: ajjhattaṃ me cittaṃ ṭhitaṃ bhavissati susaṇṭhitaṃ na cuppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassantīti
an8.63:2.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ ṭhitaṃ hoti susaṇṭhitaṃ na cuppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti tato te bhikkhu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an8.63:2.2: mettā me cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti
an8.63:3.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti bahulīkato tato tvaṃ bhikkhu imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkampi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi sappītikampi bhāveyyāsi nippītikampi bhāveyyāsi sātasahagatampi bhāveyyāsi upekkhāsahagatampi bhāveyyāsi
an8.63:4.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti subhāvito tato te bhikkhu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an8.63:4.4: upekkhā me cetovimutti bhāvitā bhavissati bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhāti
an8.63:5.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti bahulīkato tato tvaṃ bhikkhu imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkampi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi sappītikampi bhāveyyāsi nippītikampi bhāveyyāsi sātasahagatampi bhāveyyāsi upekkhāsahagatampi bhāveyyāsi
an8.63:6.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti subhāvito tato te bhikkhu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an8.63:6.2: kāye kāyānupassī viharissāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassanti
an8.63:7.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti bahulīkato tato tvaṃ bhikkhu imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkampi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi sappītikampi bhāveyyāsi nippītikampi bhāveyyāsi sātasahagatampi bhāveyyāsi upekkhāsahagatampi bhāveyyāsi
an8.63:8.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti subhāvito tato te bhikkhu evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an8.63:8.4: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharissāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassanti
an8.63:9.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti bahulīkato tato tvaṃ bhikkhu imaṃ samādhiṃ savitakkampi savicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi vicāramattaṃ bhāveyyāsi avitakkampi avicāraṃ bhāveyyāsi sappītikampi bhāveyyāsi nippītikampi bhāveyyāsi sātasahagatampi bhāveyyāsi upekkhāsahagatampi bhāveyyāsi.
an8.63:10.1: yato kho te bhikkhu ayaṃ samādhi evaṃ bhāvito hoti subhāvito tato tvaṃ bhikkhu yena yeneva tagghasi phāsu yeva tagghasi yattha yattha ṭhassasi phāsuyeva ṭhassasi yattha yattha nisīdissasi phāsu yeva nisīdissasi yattha yattha seyyaṃ kappissasi phāsu yeva seyyaṃ kappissasīti.
an8.63:11.1: athakho so bhikkhu bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi
an8.63:11.2: athakho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā samma dve agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
an8.63:11.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi
an8.63:11.4: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti. 71
